source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to data science (PDF 76-77).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter jadeed computing mein data aur us ke tajzia (analysis) se ta'aruf karata hai: data science ki bunyadein; structured aur unstructured data aur data kaise jama aur mehfooz hota hai; machine learning jis se systems data se seekh kar faisle karte hain; model ko accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score se kaise jaanchein aur validation aur tuning se kaise behtar karein; aur aakhir mein Excel, R aur Python jaise aam tools.

blocks.title: Data science
blocks.text: Data science data jama karne, munazzam karne, tajzia karne aur tashreeh karne ka shoba hai taake mufeed maloomat mile aur faisla sazi mein madad ho.

Data science kacha data ba-maani ilm mein badalti hai, aise tools aur tareeqon se jo bari miqdar ka data parakh sakein. Yeh bohat se shobon mein faislon mein madad deti, aage ke rujhanat ka andaza lagati, aur karobar, taleem aur sehat mein aam use hoti hai. Yeh naqsh dhoondne ke liye data parhti hai: data mukhtalif zaraye se jama, saaf aur munazzam, tajzia, aur nataij ehtiyat se samjhe jate hain (Fig 6.1). Yeh sawalon ke jawab haqaiq se deti aur andaze kam karti hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar dabbe: 1 collection (jama aur process), 2 exploring (parakh aur safai), 3 modelling (train aur test) aur 4 decision making (baseerat aur amal). Decision making se wapas collection tak dashed purple feedback loop: nataij naye sawal aur naya data late hain. Note un shobon ki fehrist deta jin par data science mabni hai.
blocks.caption: Data science ka workflow (Fig 6.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chakkar ahem hai: aik tajzie se jo seekha jaye woh aam taur par agla sawal uthata hai, is liye data science aik dafa nahi balke baar baar hoti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Bohat se idare faisla sazi ke liye data science use karte hain; yeh data mein chhupe rujhanat aur naqsh dekhne mein madad deti hai.

items: Riyazi: numbers aur hisab ke saath kaam.
Shumariyat (statistics): data ka tajzia aur khulasa.
Computer science: tools aur programming ki maharat.
Shobe ka ilm: asal masla samajhna, maslan tib ya karobar mein.

blocks.text: Kyunke yeh in shobon ko milati hai aur har aik doosre ko sahara deta hai, is liye data science ko kai-shobon wala (interdisciplinary) kaha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Data science ko interdisciplinary kyun kaha jata hai? Shobe ke ilm ki aik misal dein jo is ko chahiye ho.
blocks.explanation: Yeh riyazi, shumariyat, computer science, mozoo ke ilm aur abalagh ko milati hai. Maslan hospital ke data ke tajzie ko tibbi ilm chahiye taake pata ho ke kaun si pemaishein ahem hain aur nateeje ka mareezon ke liye kya matlab hai.

items: Data science kacha data faislon aur andazon ke liye ilm banati.
Workflow: jama, parakh aur safai, model, faisla, feedback ke saath.
Interdisciplinary: riyazi, shumariyat, computing, shobe ka ilm, abalagh.
